scenes.audio_transcript:
Character A says: भैया, चांदनी चौक जाने का कितना लोगे? [Brother, how much will you take to go to Chandni Chowk?]
Character B says: It will be around 100 rupees.
Character A says: 100 rupees तो थोड़ा ज्यादा है भैया। [100 rupees is a bit much, brother.]
Character B says: If you can't afford, then find some other rickshaw, please.
Character A says: अच्छा भैया, ये बताओ, I have been trying to make my boyfriend learn English, but I can't. फिर आपने कैसे सीख ली? [Okay brother, tell me this... then how did you learn it?]
Character B says: वो मैं MySivi app use करता हूँ ना। [I use the MySivi app.]
Character A says: MySivi app? वो क्या है? [MySivi app? What is that?]
Character B says: इस app में एक AI teacher है, जिसके साथ हर दिन 10-15 मिनट practice करके मैंने English सीख ली। [This app has an AI teacher, with whom I practiced for 10-15 minutes every day and learned English.]
Character A says: अरे वाह! पर ये AI तो महंगा होगा ना? [Oh wow! But this AI must be expensive, right?]
Character B says: बिल्कुल नहीं। मैंने बस ₹1 में शुरू किया था। तो अपने boyfriend को भी करवा दो। [Not at all. I started with just ₹1. So get your boyfriend to do it too.]
Character A says: ज़रूर भैया। कैसे start करूँ? [Definitely, brother. How do I start?]
Character B says: बस install button पे click करो, MySivi app install करो and 15 days English learning challenge शुरू करो। [Just click on the install button, install the MySivi app, and start the 15 days English learning challenge.]
